name: tokens-shadcn
title: Tokens — the shadcn bridge
description: Maps shadcn’s semantic names onto the brand: emphasis is inversion, destructive is the foreground rather than a red, and charts separate by lightness. Tailwind v4 only — the @theme block is a Tailwind directive. Needed by every component-tier item and by nothing in the brand tier.
author: Amir Salmani <hi@amirsalmani.com>
